name: Jen'shan
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Jen'shan teaches young hunters the ways of the wild. The Darkspear jungle troll trains orc and troll marksmen in tracking, ranged combat, and survival.

sections.title: Mentor of the Red Sands
sections.body: Jen'shan trains new hunters in the Valley of Trials. Young orcs and Darkspear trolls come to her with inscribed tablets and parchments that direct them to her. She teaches them archery, marksmanship, and wilderness survival, preparing them for the scorpids and boars on the canyon floor.

faq.answer: Jen'shan is a Darkspear jungle troll who trains hunters in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. She teaches young Horde hunters tracking, wilderness lore, and ranged combat.
Young hunters are sent to Jen'shan for introductory training. Orcs bring her an Etched Tablet, while trolls seek her out with an Etched Parchment.

faq.q: Why is a troll training hunters in an orc proving ground?
aliases: why is a troll in valley of trials
faq.answer: The Valley of Trials is a proving ground for orc recruits and the Darkspear trolls who share Durotar. Troll scouts like Jen'shan train hunters and warriors of both races for service to the Horde.

angles.text: As a young orc or troll hunter, you meet Jen'shan first. She teaches you ranged techniques before you leave the red canyons of the Den.
As a troll, you see Jen'shan carry on the Darkspear tradition of tracking and scouting, teaching young trolls their ancestral hunting ways in their new home on this continent.
